visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Range Sum Misses the Last Element
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The sum of elements 1 through 3 of 2 4 6 8 10 is 4 + 6 + 8 = 18, but the program prints 10.

solution.explanation: prefix[k] holds the sum of the first k elements, so the sum up to and including index right is prefix[right + 1]. Using prefix[right] stops one element early and leaves out a[right].
